name: Administrator creates linked academic structure
description: Creates linked academic records and verifies they remain available after refresh.
steps: Sign in as an Administrator or Super Admin
Open Academic administration
Create a faculty, department, programme and course in sequence
Refresh the module and verify the records remain listed
expected: All linked academic records remain visible after refresh; invalid parent references are rejected.

name: Lecturer publishes an announcement to a selected audience
description: Verifies a lecturer can publish an announcement for a selected audience and that the announcement persists.
steps: Sign in as a Lecturer
Open Announcements
Publish a titled message for Students
Refresh the announcement board
expected: The published announcement appears in the lecturer's view and is delivered only to the selected audience.

name: Students earn points and badges from verified attendance
description: Verifies only lecturer-verified attendance earns points and unlocks milestone badges.
steps: Sign in as a Student with a verified attendance record
Open Achievements & leaderboard
Review points, verified class count and badges
Compare the student's score with the leaderboard
expected: Each verified record contributes ten points and pending or rejected records contribute no points.

name: Student uses QR, GPS and focus policies for class attendance
description: Verifies a student checks in to a location-required session and focus interruptions are recorded according to the lecturer's selected policy.
steps: Sign in as a Lecturer and create a session with geofencing and a focus policy
Display the session QR code
Sign in as a Student inside the geofence and complete QR check-in
Enable focus monitoring for that session
Switch away from the browser and return
Review the focus event and resulting attendance state
expected: The geofence is enforced, focus interruptions are recorded, and Strict or Grace policies apply their configured attendance outcomes.

name: AI Study Hub answers questions and generates quizzes from course notes
description: Verifies authenticated users can ask an academic question and generate practice questions from supplied course material.
steps: Sign in and open AI Study Hub
Ask the assistant an academic question
Open the quiz generator and enter a topic with course notes
Generate a practice quiz
expected: The assistant returns an academic response and the quiz generator returns questions with answers and explanations.
